name: openclaw-bridge
description: Connect Codex with your OpenClaw agent to debug behavior, refine personalizations, and collaborate on tests and acceptance through an existing local CLI or SSH connection.

interface.shortDescription: Debug, personalize, and test OpenClaw with Codex
interface.longDescription: Bring your coding agent and your personal OpenClaw agent into the same feedback loop. Codex can ask about unexpected behavior, discuss new personalizations, and collect feedback on test cases and sample outputs. Follow up in the same conversation without manually relaying every reply. Connect through your existing local OpenClaw CLI or SSH setup; personal settings stay local. Conversations start in Codex. Agent feedback supports acceptance alongside real tests; it is not proof that a deployed workflow passed.
defaultPrompt: Debug this OpenClaw behavior with my agent: compare its feedback with the code, propose a fix, and verify it with tests and a follow-up example.
Help me build an OpenClaw personalization: consult my agent about available preferences, define acceptance examples, and test the change.
Ask my OpenClaw agent to review this proposed change for missing acceptance cases, then discuss the test results and sample outputs.
